items.title: 📝 Writeup – OSINT: Reverse MX (Tick Tock)
items.summary: TL;DR 📝 Writeup – OSINT: Reverse MX (Tick Tock) is an oint challenge from OSINT Combine. It is known that there are several domains that use the same mail server as Lufthansa. Of these domains, one of them has the name city in Bulgaria. Our task is to find the full domain. 📌 Question Description It is known that there are several domains that use the same mail server as Lufthansa.
